title: @better-auth/electron 1.5.0-beta.12 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 accepts any validly signed…
description: @better-auth/electron versions 1.5.0-beta.12 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 have a vulnerability where any validly signed transfer cookie is accepted, exposing full endpoint context including authentication secrets. Authenticated users can extract these secrets to forge sessions as other users. Additionally, attackers who know a password can bypass two-factor authentication by exchanging desktop authorization codes issued before two-factor verification.
